title: UI refinement, accessibility, final QA
description: Final polish: VoiceOver support (labels, announcements), keyboard navigation for all UI elements, visual consistency (spacing, colors, fonts), animation smoothness, edge cases (empty states, very long messages, unicode), macOS Ventura/Sonoma/Sequoia testing, final lint pass, memory leak check (Instruments), release build verification.
acceptance_criteria: VoiceOver: all UI elements have labels, announcements for streaming/approvals
Keyboard navigation: all UI elements reachable and operable via keyboard
Visual consistency: spacing, colors, fonts consistent across all panels
Edge cases: empty states, very long messages, unicode all handled
macOS compatibility: works on Ventura, Sonoma, Sequoia
Lint: go vet ./... clean, no warnings
Memory: Instruments profile shows no leaks
Release build: go build -ldflags='-s -w' produces working binary
